venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL Saturday 8/29 — MOD: JK.** Net sales $10,408 vs target $8,633 (+20.6%). 361 guests, ~$28.83 check avg, comps $71.20. Food $452, events $0. Last Saturday of the month — not a crazy start; opener got everything rolling. DJ Kia Lacey started at 9pm with her new sound board and the music sounded great. Big late pop from 11pm–2am with over $1,000 in sales each hour, plus an unexpected wedding crowd from across the street at the 4th. Coaching: keep checking paper products, heads-up bartending, suggest food to guests. 86'd ocho repo, low bubbles. No-shows charged. Favorite moment: Kia and her new sound board. Entered by Mya.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH Saturday 8/29 — MOD: KE/DJ.** Net sales $9,027 vs target $12,558 (−28.1%). 330 guests, $27 check avg, comps $86 (0.95%). Food $170, events $0. An abnormally slow Saturday: first pre-season Titans game plus at least two shows at Bridgestone and the Ryman made downtown an early night. Early pop before 6pm with a couple decent-sized parties, then a 'wig-out' party (everyone in wigs) from ~8:30–10pm. Slow the rest of the night until the post-Charmers pop at 1am. Kitchen smooth. No-shows not charged. Favorite moment: the wig-out party — 'we are the perfect bar for whimsy!' Entered by BT.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR Saturday 8/29 — AM MOD: MJH; PM MOD: Carey & Lucas.** Total net sales incl. events $38,795.42 vs target $17,684 (+119.4%). Non-event net $17,045.42 (DC/AM $1,944.13, D&C PM $15,028.16). Net event sales $21,750 with $9,350 event food; total food incl. events $12,811. 370 guests (Tock), comps $458.59 (2.7%). AM: smooth Saturday with Felix and Care helping; a little afternoon cocktail pop. PM: down a server and a manager to illness ('the plague has hit us early') plus a pebble-ice fiasco, but the team didn't slow down. Events: massive wedding reception for Sara & Pete, 90+ guests, 5pm–12am across all spaces — Lucas W & Rachael knocked out passed apps and a big taco bar; B&G thanked the team on the way out. Highlights: Josh crushed section and rail all night, Reagan nearly $5k in sales alone, Paige had a ~$150 single pour. No-shows not charged. Entered by Carey.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA Saturday 8/29 — MOD: Joe + Gigi.** Net sales $13,277 vs target $12,498 (+6.2%). 371 guests, GCA $89.72, comps $428 (Josh Ng, Bailey's friends, Brent + Katie, birthdays, anniversaries, service recovery, DNL). Food $2,409; Standing Room $3,359 / Marquee $9,918. A very, very busy Saturday: started with 140 covers on the books and constant walk-ins. Short-staffed but the team stepped up. Marquee full by 7pm, Standing Room filling soon after; both rooms jumping by 8pm with a growing waitlist. Busiest hours 8:30–10pm; waitlist strong until 11pm when everyone waiting was accommodated. SR cleared ~midnight and guests were moved to Marquee; strong presence at last call with a smooth ending. Kitchen: very busy, crushed it. No-shows charged. Favorite moment: the team stepping up while short-staffed. Entered by Joe.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC Saturday 8/29 — MOD: Josh/Jesse.** Total net sales incl. events $10,341.36 vs target $9,445 (+9.5%). Marquee bar $8,465.36, Garden $187, food $1,005.19. 221 guests (91 Resy / 130 walk-in), GA $41.70 / GCA $76.35. Comps $161.84 (1.5% — GDTs, investors, walkout due to a Toast issue), voids $132 (1.3%). Garden: humid slow start, picked up dramatically after sundown — busy from 9pm with waitlisted guests and large parties; Jada rocked it. Marquee: strong from the jump; down a host, so Chaz moved to host and Josh worked the floor until the closing crew arrived at 7pm — operations without a hitch. Lull ~8–8:45pm, then strong through last call. Kitchen: James solo, solid night; nearly ran out of chips but Josh made a store run. Maintenance: rodents in kitchen, many flies, sani sink draining slowly. Favorite moment: Mai Tai for 2 in the boat! No-shows not charged. Entered by Jesse.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG Saturday 8/29 — AM MOD: Sam/Justin & Shannon; PM MOD: Braden/Marcus.** Total net sales $12,830 vs target $11,000 (+16.6%). Municipal Bar AM $2,966 (90 guests) / PM $7,569 (204 guests); Hot Eye $2,272; Sun Club $0 (closed for on/off showers). Food $4,112, comps $388, events $0. Morning: quiet until noon, good hour 12:30–1:30, steady through brunch and happy hour. Evening: only 41 on the books but much busier with walk-ins and large group drinkers; team handled it well with just one support role — shout-out to Kaylee. Earl trained with Chandler and broke off to tackle support work solo. Hot Eye: slow start, birthday crew ~9:30, then packed from 11pm — the entire Common Thread staff came in and it stayed 100% industry until the lights came on, the biggest industry crowd since the GinRoom pop-up. Maintenance: Hot Eye tap-line leak, men's bathroom issue. Favorite moment: the service industry showing UP in THE<3. Entered by Alexis.
